New.definition: Captured but never contacted. Most fields are empty and no property has been liked or shown.
expected_populated_fields: at least one of: phone, email
agent_actions: Goal of the first call is identification, not qualification: confirm the name, confirm they made the enquiry, and establish lead_type.
Do not pitch inventory before lead_type is known.
Never schedule a site visit on a lead whose lead_type is still blank.
New.handling_sparse_records: If only a phone number exists, open by naming the source ('you enquired on 99acres about a property in Sector 82'). If the source is a chatbot or an illegible sign-in and nothing can be confirmed, ask a single open question and let them lead.

agent_actions: Complete the required_fields for the lead_type before proposing any property.
Set next_followup_date on every call, agreed with the lead.

Qualified.definition: Required fields captured and the requirement is within our service area and inventory.
agent_actions: Share a shortlist matched to preferred_areas, property_type and budget range.
Record every property the lead reacts positively to in liked_property_ids.
Propose a site visit only for properties confirmed available that week.

Buyer.objective: Understand the requirement and financial readiness before showing anything.
qualification_questions: Which locations are you looking at, and is there a commute or school that anchors you there?
What budget range are you working with, all-in?
Is this a self-use purchase or an investment?
Are you funding this through a home loan or own funds?
Are you currently renting, or do you need to sell something first?
What is your realistic timeline to close?
permitted: Explaining project approvals, RERA registration status, carpet vs super built-up area, and possession timelines, where verified.
Introducing a lender only after asking permission to share their contact details.
prohibited: Quoting an EMI, loan eligibility or interest rate as advice.
Advising on stamp duty or tax treatment.
Showing a property outside the recorded budget range without the lead's consent to look higher.
Pressuring a first-time buyer to pay a token amount on a first visit.
Buyer.cadence: Twice weekly while Active - Showing; weekly while Qualified; monthly in Nurture.
escalate_if: Lead asks to structure the deal partly in cash
Lead is buying on behalf of an undisclosed third party

Seller.objective: Establish the property, the motivation, and whether the price expectation is achievable.
qualification_questions: Where is the property and what is the configuration?
Is the title clear, and are the approvals and society NOC in order?
Is it self-occupied, tenanted or vacant?
What price are you expecting, and how did you arrive at it?
Is the property currently listed with anyone else?
By when do you need to conclude the sale?
permitted: Presenting a comparative market analysis with the actual comparables it was built from.
Telling a seller honestly that their expectation is above market, with evidence.
prohibited: Inflating an indicative valuation to win the mandate.
Listing or advertising a property before a signed mandate is in hand.
Marketing a property already under an exclusive mandate with another firm.
Accepting a mandate without sighting ownership documents.
Seller.cadence: Weekly market and enquiry update while the property is live. Never go silent on a listed seller for more than 10 days.
escalate_if: Ownership is disputed or the seller cannot produce title documents
Property is subject to litigation, an unresolved loan, or an inheritance dispute

Renter.objective: Match quickly. Rental leads move fast and go cold faster.
Renter.budget_note: budget_min and budget_max on a Renter record are MONTHLY rent in INR, not a purchase price. Never render them with sale formatting.
qualification_questions: What is your monthly budget, and does that include or exclude maintenance?
When does your current lease end or when do you need possession?
How many occupants, and are there pets?
Which localities work for your commute?
permitted: Explaining standard deposit norms, lock-in periods, and maintenance liability for the locality.
Setting expectations honestly where a society or owner has restrictions we must disclose.
prohibited: Passing on or acting upon an owner's discriminatory preference regarding religion, caste, community, marital status, food habits or region of origin. Decline the mandate instead.
Collecting a token or deposit before the owner has confirmed availability in writing.
Charging the tenant a fee not disclosed at the first showing.
Renter.cadence: Every 2-3 days until placed. Rental urgency is real and follow-up gaps lose the deal.
escalate_if: Owner insists on a discriminatory tenant filter
Owner asks for rent partly in cash

Unclassified.definition: lead_type is blank. Applies to most New records, including chatbot and sign-in captures with only a phone number.
Unclassified.objective: Establish identity and intent. Nothing else.
agent_actions: Open by naming the source and the enquiry so the lead can place the call.
Ask one open question: whether they are looking to buy, rent, sell or invest.
Set lead_type before any other field is filled.
If two contact attempts establish nothing, move to Attempted Contact cadence. Do not guess a lead_type and start pitching.
prohibited: Pitching inventory to a lead whose intent is unknown.
Adding an unclassified lead to any marketing campaign.
